label: GO after unrewarded trial, ramping late in episode, scaled by belief S1 good
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 30, 0)**1.5 ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 30, 0)**1.5 * belief ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.maximum(ep_trial - 30, 0)**1.5 ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 30, 0)**1.5
explanation: Active only at GO, so D1 and D2 are always zero. Magnitude is the product of three things: (1) the previous trial was unrewarded (after a rewarded trial it stays near zero, so the 4th term cancels the late-episode timing baseline there); (2) a steep ramp in episode trial that starts around trial 30 and grows superlinearly (an additive per-decile baseline cannot capture this interaction, which is why the additive all ceiling is only 0.28); (3) the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good, i.e. it is largest when the agent should go to a1, plus an extra boost after a1->S2 unrewarded (rare-unrewarded a1, after which a model-based agent repeats a1). Dev R^2 beyond timing: 0.23 for prev-trial indicators alone, 0.47 with a linear ep_trial interaction, 0.73 with ramp x belief and the rewarded-trial cancel term, 0.75 with the ^1.5 ramp from trial 30. Adding the trial-before reward did not help (+0.000). Adding the future GO choice (a1) added only +0.008 (0.743 vs 0.735), so belief stands in for the model policy and the observed-only version loses almost nothing. Misses: peak amplitudes (3.5 to 4.4) are under-predicted on individual windows, and some unrewarded a2 trials still fire.

issues: Most of the story holds up. The feature fires only at GO: the D1 and D2 residuals are 0 everywhere. The recorded terms reproduce test R^2 beyond timing of 0.738. Adding the future choice (action == 1) adds only +0.005 on test (0.7437), so the observed-only claim holds.

'After an unrewarded trial' overclaims. The residual table by previous trial gives GO after a1 S2 u +0.82. After the other unrewarded patterns it is close to the rewarded ones: a2 S2 u +0.06, a1 S1 u -0.09, a2 S1 u -0.10. Misses on the original terms are systematically over-predicted at GO after a1 S1 u (-0.178) and GO after a1 S2 u (-0.109). In the worst windows, GO after a1 S1c unrewarded is predicted at about 1.0 but the actual value is 0. The broad prev_reward==0 term spreads mass onto histories that do not fire.
Belief does not do what the explanation says. Without the a1 S2 u term, ramp x belief gets only 0.564 on test. The 'extra boost' after a1 S2 u is therefore the main effect, not a small addition.

The ramp shape is wrong. Changing the start from 30 to 40 and the exponent from 1.5 to 2 raises the same four terms to 0.783 on test. Adding a prev_action==1 term gives 0.819. 'Starts around trial 30, ^1.5' is not the best description; the ramp is closer to quadratic from about trial 40.

Better terms (8) reach test 0.831 against the recorded 0.738. The leftover systematic error is at GO after a2 S2 u (-0.094, over-predicted). Some repeated a2 S2c-unrewarded streaks do build up firing (1.7, then 3.2, then a1 at 3.99), which the terms capture only partly.
